false_claims_note: `false_claims` counts RUNS that reported done while the independent recomputation (the code check) says they were not right. It is not a statement that the model lied about a figure: in the first held-out round every navigator's own claim was true as worded and what was wrong was the form the harness accepted (`harness_accepted_wrong_inputs`).
